observation_indicators.observable_fil: Kumpleto ang limang field; natutukoy ang apektadong gawain na ihihinto, ligtas na alternatibo at awtorisadong contact; kasama ang heat, ruta at balik; may batayan ng ready/hindi pa ready at tapat na hindi pa nakumpirma; inuulit ang briefing matapos ang feedback.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Completes five fields; identifies the affected work to pause, safe alternative and authorized contact; includes heat, route and return time; records evidence for ready/not-ready and honest unknowns; repeats the briefing after feedback.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Itinutuloy ang mapanganib na ruta o gawaing kulang ang proteksyon para lang matapos ang target.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Continues an unsafe route or unprotected task simply to finish the target.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Kumpleto ang limang field; natutukoy ang apektadong gawain na ihihinto, ligtas na alternatibo at awtorisadong contact; kasama ang heat, ruta at balik; may batayan ng ready/hindi pa ready at tapat na hindi pa nakumpirma; inuulit ang briefing matapos ang feedback. Nagagawa nang walang prompt; hindi minamarkahang ready ang hindi pa beripikado.
levels.kaya_na_en: Completes five fields; identifies the affected work to pause, safe alternative and authorized contact; includes heat, route and return time; records evidence for ready/not-ready and honest unknowns; repeats the briefing after feedback. Does this without prompting; never marks an unverified condition ready.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Ligtas ang pause decision ngunit kulang ang field, contact o batayan ng beripikasyon. Punan sa tulong ng prompt at ulitin ang briefing.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Makes a safe pause decision but misses a field, contact or verification evidence. Complete it with prompting and repeat the briefing.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Itinutuloy ang mapanganib na ruta o gawaing kulang ang proteksyon para lang matapos ang target.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Continues an unsafe route or unprotected task simply to finish the target.
